status: incomplete — placeholder categories only, no tokens finalized
governance: Adding an icon token is a change-request event, same as a color token. Not yet populated: doing so now would mean inventing bespoke icon shapes on the spot, which is exactly the pattern that produced a hand-drawn DB-cylinder icon in an earlier draft, later reverted as a mistake. Needs a deliberate follow-up task to pick a consistent icon style (stroke weight, viewBox, visual language) before any token gets an actual value.
fallback: Any item without an approved icon token renders as a plain colored dot (item.dotColor) instead — never a forced mismatched icon and never a newly hand-drawn one.

categoriesNeeded.usage: Inbound Actors items — human users, applications, browsers

categoriesNeeded.notes: already has a validated non-icon treatment (circular +/badge glyph drawn directly by the renderer) — may not need a catalog token at all

categoriesNeeded.usage: Systems of Record items — must stay a plain box + icon, never a DB-cylinder/file shape
Paired with 'warning' semantic pills, not a replacement for them
